external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A person who uses the loyalty programme, collects points, spends them on gift cards, and connects partner apps.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members collect points when they shop and spend them on gift cards.

external_entities.name: member phone
external_entities.description: A phone used by a member to run the mobile app and retain a refresh token.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.

external_entities.name: browser
external_entities.description: A browser used for authorization-server sign-in, consent, and redirect handling.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The member-facing mobile application that signs members in, calls the rewards API, and manages partner-app connections.
processes.notes: Nobody wrote down whether the app sends a PKCE challenge.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: The authorization service that signs members in, issues authorization codes and tokens, handles consent, and manages partner-app authorization.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
processes.technology: authorization code flow; JWT token signing

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: The API that validates access tokens and reads and writes the points ledger.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
processes.notes: It does not check which client or which audience a token was issued for.

processes.name: partner app
processes.description: A web application operated by another company, such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points.
processes.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

processes.name: support console
processes.description: A web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: The database holding member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, consents, and account-closure state.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: The ledger holding every member's balance and every points transaction.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: The store receiving every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: use mobile app
data_flows.description: A member uses the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members use our mobile app.
data_flows.data_description: Member loyalty activity and account interactions

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: The mobile app signs a member in through the authorization server using the authorization code flow.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

data_flows.name: call rewards API
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back

data_flows.name: store refresh token
data_flows.description: The mobile app keeps a refresh token on the member's phone.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.

data_flows.name: request token
data_flows.description: A partner app sends token requests containing its client secret to the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.

data_flows.name: sign in and consent
data_flows.description: A member signs in and approves the consent screen in a browser.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser and approves a consent screen

data_flows.name: authorize
data_flows.description: The browser interacts with the authorization server's sign-in page and consent screen.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser and approves a consent screen
data_flows.data_description: Sign-in credentials, consent, and authorization request

data_flows.name: return authorization code
data_flows.description: The browser returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.

data_flows.name: disconnect partner app
data_flows.description: The mobile app requests disconnection of a partner app, causing its refresh token to be deleted from the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members can disconnect a partner app from the settings screen of the mobile app

data_flows.name: manage identity data
data_flows.description: The authorization server stores and manages member identity, authorization, token, consent, and account state data.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database, together with the authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents it issues.
data_flows.data_description: Member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, consents, and account state

data_flows.name: update points ledger
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes balances and points transactions in the ledger.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

data_flows.name: write API logs
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes every received request, including headers, to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: use support console
data_flows.description: A browser connects to and uses the support console web application.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_flows.name: get access token
data_flows.description: The support console obtains or uses access tokens from the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It takes access tokens from the same authorization server

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.

trust_boundaries.name: our cloud
trust_boundaries.description: The organization's own cloud account where the authorization server, rewards API, support console, and stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: member phones
trust_boundaries.description: The members' phones, which are outside the organization's cloud account.

trust_boundaries.name: partner servers
trust_boundaries.description: Servers operated by other companies for their partner applications.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The rewards API is internet-facing because it is served on a public hostname.
assumptions.basis: The text says the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The support console is internet-facing because it is served on a public hostname.
assumptions.basis: The text says the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The identity database contains confidential data because it stores member personal information and credentials.
assumptions.basis: It stores member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger contains confidential data because it stores member-linked balances and points transactions.
assumptions.basis: It holds every member's balance and every points transaction.
